buffer_name.description: Buffer solution used during loading isotherm experiment.

salt_name.description: Name/identity of the salt used in the experiment.

process_id_field.description: Process identifier recorded in eLabFTW metadata (may differ from PROCESS_ID).

pump_speed.description: Pump speed setting used for loading / equilibration steps (as entered in eLabFTW).

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per (ligand, salt) condition on the plate.

resin_mass_mg.description: Mass of resin used per condition.

ligand_name.description: Name/identity of the ligand loaded onto the resin.

total_volume_uL.description: Total liquid volume in each well used in the loading isotherm.

venting_time_s.description: Duration of venting step during loading/equilibration.

pump_duration_s.description: Duration for which the pump was running per cycle.

incubation_time_min.description: Incubation time for the loading isotherm experiment.

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used across the plate.

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of equilibration cycles applied before measurement.

equilibration_volume_uL.description: Volume used for each equilibration cycle.

ligand_concentrations.description: List of initial ligand concentrations used in the plate layout.

measurement_wavelength_nm.description: Measurement wavelength for absorbance readout on the Tecan plate reader.

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the linear calibration curve relating absorbance to ligand concentration.

salt_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the salt stock solution used for dilutions.

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the ligand stock solution used for dilutions.

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the linear calibration curve relating absorbance to ligand concentration.

equilibration_cycle_duration_s.description: Duration of a single equilibration cycle.

num_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations used on the plate.

num_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations used on the plate.

analysis_status.description: Status of the Tecan loading isotherm analysis.

analysis_timestamp.description: UTC timestamp when results were stored to the database.

summary.description: Key metrics summarizing Langmuir fits across salt concentrations.

num_salt_concentrations.description: Number of salt concentrations included in the fit results.

num_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of ligand concentrations included in the analysis.

replicates.description: Number of replicate wells per condition (from analysis metadata).

n_points_total.description: Total number of (c0, salt) data points used for Langmuir fitting.

n_salt_fit_success.description: Number of salt concentrations where Langmuir fitting succeeded.

n_salt_fit_failed.description: Number of salt concentrations where Langmuir fitting failed.

qmax_mean.description: Mean fitted qmax over successful salt conditions.

qmax_std.description: Standard deviation of fitted qmax over successful salt conditions.

K_mean.description: Mean fitted Langmuir affinity constant K over successful salt conditions.

K_std.description: Standard deviation of fitted Langmuir affinity constant K over successful salt conditions.

r2_mean.description: Mean R^2 of Langmuir fits over successful salt conditions.

r2_std.description: Standard deviation of R^2 over successful salt conditions.

analysis_metadata.description: Subset of analysis metadata returned by the analysis script.

data_files.description: Output data file names and paths from the analysis script.

plots.description: Generated plot file names and paths.

fit_results_per_salt.description: Per-salt Langmuir fit parameters and quality metrics.
